title: Giantbreaker

sources.title: Heavy Hitter
markers: | summary = '''Heavy Hitter''' is a passive feature that sends opponents reeling on every hit.

summary: This +1 heavy crossbow adds two turns of Reeling on a hit.

fields.Weapon damage: 1d10 + 1 Piercing plus the wielder’s Dexterity modifier. +1 enchantment also improves attack rolls. Martial, two-handed ranged weapon, 60 ft range, dippable.
fields.Weapon actions: With proficiency, gain Piercing Shot and Brace (Ranged).
fields.Heavy Hitter: Hits from Giantbreaker add two turns of Reeling, up to ten. Each remaining turn gives the target a −1 attack roll penalty. The target’s next attack clears all stacks whether it hits or misses. A Multiattack action applies the penalty to its attacks before the duration changes.
fields.Base value: 380 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
